tasks.title: Doctor v0 (Word): verified repairs behind ?doctor=1 (prototype)
tasks.description: Upload DOCX -> analyse -> proposed repairs -> review -> repaired file -> SafeEdit check -> download only when verified. Repairs in the Word file (empty paragraphs as spacing, too-wide pictures/tables) and safe editor repairs (proposals). Refusals: no Word file, unusable source, import word check not passed, undecided tracked changes, signed, macros, damaged package, a file the export itself would change; per block: preserved features.
tasks.acceptance: Every repaired file verified (words, header/footer words, untouched blocks byte for byte, preserved features, valid package) or nothing handed out; refused files say why; original never written; no AI; feature flag
tasks.test_result: tests/test_doctor.py 72 (whole Word corpus refused-for-a-reason or verified; labelled corpus vs ground truth; each SafeEdit check caught on a damaged result; refusals; repairs in the file never touch tables, last paragraph, carriers; skipped when not lined up), tests/test_doctor_api.py 9, e2e/doctor.spec.ts 4 (flag, full flow + download, signed refused, Bulgarian), axe light/dark on the panel. Measured: 15/23 planted defects repaired (65 %), 15/15 of the kinds v0 repairs bar one left on purpose; 0 wrong proposals.
tasks.notes: Gaps: fonts set on a whole paragraph (imported as a paragraph rule), formatting repeating the style (folded away on import). SafeEdit found: the export rewrites a neighbouring block when the editor rewrites a table (B-022) -- mitigated by preferring repairs in the file. Not a finished product.

decisions.decision: Branch + its own Preview; Production unchanged without approval
Approved Canva-inspired original design system; seven screens
Preview shares the production DB/bucket: no schema change or destructive operation without approval; new models in JSONB with kind+schema_version
Two kinds (flow, canvas) in one store; paragraphs never free boxes
Use existing adapters; paid keys/providers need approval
Proposal -> preview -> accept/reject; reject changes nothing
Dedicated panel; segment-level; new document by default; overflow warnings

Interface in Bulgarian and English: first visit from the browser language (bg -> BG, else EN); manual switch in Settings (and sign-in pages); remembered per browser (cookie, 1 year); independent of document language and Translate; centralised dictionaries; tests for both languages and persistence

decisions.topic: Canvas documents and the shared database
decisions.decision: Option (a). Rev 2 approved in part (2026-10-15): S1-S5 done (separate free project, schema, markers, private bucket; production only read); S6-S9 refused for now (no Vercel variables, no switching redeploy, no Free Design writes, old test accounts untouched).

Context, not a scope change: Document Doctor/Repair, SafeEdit/Protect, Verify, FormatDNA, TruthSync, structure-preserving translation. Roadmap unchanged, editor stays; E2 first, then the Doctor + SafeEdit analysis (done), no large implementation without approval.

Repairs either in the Word file itself (minimal edits) or in the editor (proposals); the smaller edit wins on the same block; a repaired file is handed out only when SafeEdit verified it against the original; refusals are explicit; deterministic, no AI; prototype behind ?doctor=1 and DOCTOR_ENABLED.
